rawContent: Thank you for your leadership @JSchuurMD - word is your faculty feel supported and seen by the way you are speaking up and discussing racism and violence against Black people. #BlackLivesMatter

Demonstrated with my fellow physicians today - we must commit to keep pushing forward and using our power and privilege after this moment has passed. #WhiteCoatsForBlackLives #BlackLivesMatter #DismantleWhiteSupremacy https://t.co/byR3r2QkOD

I will be speaking at @RIHospital on Sunday before we go to the State House to demonstrate with Gen Z. I asked myself if - as a white doctor - I have the right to speak...& then realized - as a white doctor - I have the responsibility to speak. #CodeBlackRI #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/vf4qrDPsAk
